context.body: The bounded canonical source is Joshua 5:2–12; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Joshua circumcises those born in the wilderness, Israel remains at Gilgal until healing, Passover is kept, produce of the land is eaten, and manna ceases.
observations.label: A wilderness generation is circumcised before Passover: action
A wilderness generation is circumcised before Passover: response

payload.posture: Read Joshua 5:2–12 as tribes in the land evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Covenant sign, bodily vulnerability, remembered deliverance, new food, and the end of manna converge before further conquest.
payload.title: A wilderness generation is circumcised before Passover
